title: AoPSML Main Page
text:
The AoPSML, short for Art of Problem Solving Markup Language provides a way for you to incorporate AoPS data into your page without having to rely on API calls. AoPSML is both a superset and a subset of HTML as it does not allow all HTML tags but adds tags specific to Art of Problem Solving's community website.
